subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does “aprobar un examen” mean?
questions.explain: “Aprobar” means “to pass”; to fail is “suspender”.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I find maths difficult”?
questions.explain: “Me resultan difíciles” = “I find them difficult”; the verb agrees with the plural “las matemáticas”.

questions.q: How do you say “My dream is to become a lawyer”?
questions.explain: “Hacerse” = “to become” and “abogado” = “lawyer”, so “Mi sueño es hacerme abogado”.

questions.q: What does “las prácticas laborales” mean?
questions.explain: “Las prácticas laborales” means “work experience / a work placement”.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to be a nurse'?
questions.explain: 'Me gustaría' (conditional) = 'I would like' and 'enfermero' = 'nurse'; 'enfermo' means 'ill', a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: How do you say “We wear a uniform”?
questions.explain: “Llevar” = “to wear” and “llevamos” = “we wear”, so “Llevamos uniforme”.

questions.q: Which means “The pay is low but I enjoy the work”?
options: El suelo es bajo pero disfruto del trabajo
El sueldo es bajo pero disfruto del trabajo
El sueldo es alto pero disfruto del trabajo
El sueldo es bajo pero odio el trabajo
questions.explain: “El sueldo es bajo” = the pay is low and “disfruto del trabajo” = I enjoy the work.

questions.q: What does “la formación” mean in a careers context?
questions.explain: “La formación” means “training/education” for a job.

questions.q: What does “ganarse la vida” mean?
questions.explain: “Ganarse la vida” is an idiom meaning “to earn a living”.

questions.q: What does “jubilarse” mean?
questions.explain: “Jubilarse” means “to retire” from work.

questions.q: What does “la asignatura” mean?
questions.explain: “La asignatura” means “a school subject”; it is a false friend with “signature” (la firma).

questions.q: What does “el bombero” mean?
questions.explain: “El bombero” means “a firefighter”.

questions.q: What does 'el desempleo' mean?
questions.explain: 'El desempleo' (also 'el paro') means 'unemployment'; 'el empleo' is 'employment/a job'.

questions.q: What does 'el billete de ida y vuelta' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ida y vuelta' means 'there and back', so 'el billete de ida y vuelta' = 'a return ticket'.

questions.q: What does “la nota” mean in “mi nota de inglés”?
questions.explain: In school Spanish “la nota” means “the mark/grade”.

questions.q: How do you say “My favourite subject is geography”?
options: Mi asignatura aburrida es la geografía
Mi asignatura preferida es la geografía
Mi asignatura preferida es la historia
Mi firma preferida es la geografía
questions.explain: “Asignatura preferida” = favourite subject and “la geografía” = geography.

questions.q: How do you say “My ambition is to set up my own business”?
options: Mi ambición es montar tu propio negocio
Mi ambición es montar mi propio negocio
Mi ambición es cerrar mi propio negocio
Mi ambición son montar mi propio negocio
questions.explain: “Montar un negocio” = to set up a business and “propio” = own.

questions.q: What does “una entrevista de trabajo” mean?
questions.explain: “Una entrevista” = an interview, so “una entrevista de trabajo” = “a job interview”.

questions.q: What does 'los fuegos artificiales' mean?
questions.explain: 'Los fuegos artificiales' literally 'artificial fires' means 'fireworks'.

questions.q: Which means “The rules are very strict”?
questions.explain: “Las normas” = the rules and “estrictas” = strict.

questions.q: How do you say “I work part-time in a shop”?
options: Trabajas a tiempo parcial en una tienda
Trabajo a tiempo completo en una tienda
Trabajo a tiempo parcial en una empresa
Trabajo a tiempo parcial en una tienda
questions.explain: “A tiempo parcial” = part-time and “una tienda” = a shop, so the first option is correct.

questions.q: What does “la pizarra” mean?
questions.explain: “La pizarra” means “the board/whiteboard” in the classroom.
